name: ngx-pos-print
description: Angular library for POS and document printing, thermal receipts over Bluetooth, Network, USB or a local agent, and A4 documents printed silently through the host's own drivers.
author: Gildas

scripts.prepublishOnly:
node -e "console.error('
  Ne publiez pas depuis la racine : le manifeste du depot n a ni module ni exports.
  Utilisez: npm run release
'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.pack: npm run build && cd dist && npm pack
scripts.release: npm run build && cd dist && npm publish
